traditional_28_36_benchmark.source: Fannie Mae / Freddie Mac Underwriting Standards (Traditional Manual Underwriting)
traditional_28_36_benchmark.status_notice: Traditional industry benchmark. Not a universal regulatory requirement; automated underwriting systems (Desktop Underwriter / Loan Product Advisor) routinely approve DTIs up to 45% or 50% with compensating factors.

qualified_mortgage_atr.general_qm_pricing_threshold: Loan APR must not exceed Average Prime Offer Rate (APOR) by 2.25 percentage points or more for first-lien mortgages
qualified_mortgage_atr.legacy_dti_cap_context: Historical 43% strict DTI limit replaced by CFPB revised General QM pricing-based framework

compounding_standard.framework: Truth in Lending Act (TILA) / Regulation Z
compounding_standard.formula: PITI = P&I (annuity) + Monthly Property Tax + Monthly Home Insurance + Monthly PMI
